error_in_round1.description: Source/sink terms Gamma(1-q) [1/T] and gamma0*q(1-q) [1/T] were incorrectly added to the telegraph equation whose terms all have dimension [1/T^2]
error_in_round1.root_cause: Reaction terms enter the continuity equation (first-order), not the second-order wave equation directly

two_equation_system.equation_II: tau_c * partial_t J_c + J_c = -D0 * nabla(ln q)
two_equation_system.dimensions: All terms in Eq.I: [1/T]; All terms in Eq.II: [L/T]

correction_method.combined_second_order: tau_c * partial_t^2 q + [1 - tau_c * R'(q)] * partial_t q = D0 * nabla^2(ln q) + R(q)

theorem_2_1.statement: If the discrete directed graph G_N is not strongly connected for all finite N (alpha=0), then the unique bounded steady-state solution of the continuum limit equation is q(x) ≡ 0
proof_outline: Weak convergence: empirical measure mu_N -> q(x,t)dx
Discrete absorbing state |1>^⊗N corresponds to q≡0 in continuum
Spectral gap survives continuum limit because mass M = integral q dx is NOT conserved (Fleming-Thiele condition fails)
Spatial coupling (gradient terms) redistributes |0> but cannot compensate local absorption
Trotter-Kato theorem guarantees strong convergence of Lindblad semigroups
theorem_2_1.rigor_level: physicist-level (proof outline complete; full functional-analysis proof deferred)
theorem_2_1.fleming_thiele_exclusion: DGF dynamics does NOT satisfy mass conservation condition; Fleming-Thiele (2011) counterexample does not apply

theorem_2_2.statement: With L2 present (alpha > 0), the corrected telegraph equation admits non-trivial steady-state solutions whose attractor structure mirrors the strongly-connected-component decomposition of the discrete directed graph

l2_chi_bridging.problem: What is the relationship between A's L2 creation operator and B's chi braking mechanism?
l2_chi_bridging.key_insight: L2's effective rate Gamma_eff equals the rate at which fluctuations regenerate anti-correlated pairs (chi<0) in a positively-correlated background

chi_matrix_dynamics.jump_direction: Each jump L_{ij} converts chi_{ij}<0 (anti-correlated, active) to chi_{ij}>0 (correlated, frozen) — natural braking
chi_matrix_dynamics.fluctuation_regeneration: Noise term eta_ij(t) temporarily creates new chi<0 pairs, restarting local jump activity

gamma_eff_derivation.method: Kramers escape rate theory in chi-space

parameters.N_eff: effective number of correlated neighbors (~coordination number z)
parameters.chi_bar: mean positive correlation strength on edges

gamma_eff_derivation.physical_interpretation: When chi_bar is large (strongly frozen), Gamma_eff is exponentially suppressed — system is nearly static. When chi_bar is small (weakly correlated), Gamma_eff ~ gamma0 — system remains active.

unified_picture.l2_microscopic: L2 = sqrt(Gamma)*|0><1| — explicit quantum jump creating |0> from |1>
unified_picture.chi_braking_view: Gamma_eff — rate of fluctuation-driven regeneration of anti-correlated pairs
unified_picture.ibtre_view: Gamma_eff — rate of information backflow from environment memory (IBTRES channel)
unified_picture.equivalence: All three descriptions capture the same physical process at different levels of coarse-graining

IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_1: Cattaneo flux form J=-D0*grad(ln q)-tau*d_t J is assumed, not derived from DGF axioms
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_1: Cattaneo form is the minimal finite-propagation-speed diffusion framework consistent with DGF's causal structure. Rigorous derivation from microscopic jump dynamics (hydrodynamic limit) is deferred to Round 3.
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_2: Seltmann-Buca continuum limit proof is physicist-level, not a mathematical theorem. Spectral gap argument may fail at k->0 (diffusion modes)
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_2: Diffusion modes have D*k^2 gap that closes as k->0, but this produces critical slowing down, not new steady states. Mass non-conservation prevents zero-mode from generating new NESS. Argument is sound at physicist level.
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_3: Gamma_eff exponential suppression predicts zero activity in cosmological thermodynamic limit N~10^80, contradicting observed cosmic activity
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_3: This is a genuine tension. Resolution candidates: (a) causal horizon limits effective N, (b) scale-free graph topology produces non-exponential (power-law) fluctuation regeneration, (c) we are in pre-asymptotic regime. Flagged as open problem for Round 3.
IC4_adversarial_audit.attack_4: Planck-scale predictions (w~10^{-35} m) make direct experimental falsification impossible
IC4_adversarial_audit.response_4: Falsifiability exists through collective effects (Turing instability amplification) and numerical simulations (site-resolved MC). If gamma0 differs from 1/tP (e.g., DGF lattice spacing > lP), scales become larger and potentially testable.

bridge_to_B.convergence_point: Both A (L2 creation operator) and B (chi braking) describe the same physics: L2 is the operator representation of the fluctuation-driven regeneration of anti-correlated pairs (chi<0) that B identified as the fuel for causal jumps
bridge_to_B.a_contribution_to_B: Provides dimensional-correct telegraph framework for B's K_eff ecological equation; provides explicit Gamma_eff formula connecting chi_bar to creation rate
bridge_to_B.b_contribution_to_A: Chi braking explains WHY alpha=0 leads to heat death without needing L2 — because chi can only go from negative to positive in pure-L1 dynamics; provides the microscopic mechanism behind Seltmann-Buca's graph connectivity criterion
bridge_to_B.unresolved_tension: A requires explicit L2 (new operator, new parameter Gamma); B claims no new axioms needed. Resolution: L2 may be 'emergent' from chi fluctuations in the thermodynamic limit — a form of entropic creation force
